findings.description: `scores[term] = frequency + title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0` parses as `(frequency + title_bonus) if term in title_terms else 0.0`. Every term absent from the title gets a score of 0.0, so body frequency is discarded. Ranking then only favours title terms, and the rest are ordered alphabetically. With no title (the default), every score is 0.0, so extract_keywords returns alphabetically first terms with score 0.0, which breaks existing callers. suggest_tags then filters them all out with MIN_SCORE.
findings.suggestion: Add the bonus conditionally: `scores[term] = frequency + (title_bonus if term in title_terms else 0.0)`.
findings.title: Conditional expression precedence zeroes the score of every term not in the title
